title: Local limits of uniform triangulations with boundaries in high genus
summary: We study the local limits of uniform random triangulations with boundaries in the regime where the genus is proportional to the number of faces. Budzinski and Louf proved in 2020 that when there are no boundaries, the local limits exist and are the Planar Stochastic Hyperbolic Triangulation (PSHT) introduced in PSHT. We show that when the triangulations considered have size n and boundaries with total length p that tends to infinity with n and p=o(n), the local limits around a typical boundary edge are the half-plane hyperbolic triangulations defined by Angel and Ray.
